tasks.short: Lock doors and check appliances so hazards are not left overnight.

steps.what: Walk the building and monitor safety hazards
Record the closing check of electrical appliance use

tasks.design: A closing list on the {WORKFLOW} names the doors and the electrical appliances for that site, and the janitor ticks it at the end of the round. The walk, the look for hazards, and the locking stay in person. A door still open stays on the list until the janitor marks it locked.
tasks.previous_blocker: The round is a walk through rooms that change each evening, so a fixed script could not see an open door or a heater left on.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured checklist can hold the door and appliance list for each site. The janitor still walks it.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing a real hazard, and turning a key in a door that sticks, stays on the person in the building.
tasks.human_edge: The janitor can tell a heater left on from one that is meant to run, and can see a door that looks shut but is not latched.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the round. The janitor does not gain the right to change access rules or to skip a door.

reach.task: Note rooms left unsecured at the end of a room clean
reach.learn: Which doors the cleaners already expect to find open, so the closing list does not double-count them.

evidence.claim: A site checklist can list doors and appliances to tick after a walk. It does not see the rooms. This is model knowledge of ordinary facilities practice, and this job has no digest.

assumptions: The checklist fields are site, door or appliance name, state (locked, off, or exception), and the janitor's name. The facilities supervisor maintains the list. If there is no list, the janitor writes the same four fields on paper.
A closing log can be read as monitoring the janitor. National works-council rules vary and must be checked before the log is required.
unknowns: Whether this site already has a door list, and whether any doors are on an electronic lock rather than a key.
research_questions: How often a missed lock is found the next morning, versus how often the paper note is simply lost.

already_counted.description: The janitor still checks the ticked closing list against the doors just walked.

incremental.description: Add or retire a door or appliance on the list when the site changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the paper closing note shrinks, and only on sites that already have a stable door list. The walk and the locking stay. Upkeep of the list is taken off. A site with shifting rooms saves less.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Tell managers when a building system needs a major repair.

steps.what: Notice a fault in building operating systems
Judge whether the fault needs major repairs
Write a repair note for managers
Tell managers about that repair in person

tasks.design: The janitor still finds the fault and still tells the manager. A short repair notice on the {WORKFLOW} carries the location, the building system, and what was seen, so the ask is not only a hallway conversation. The decision to commission the repair stays with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether a leak or a noise is a major repair is a judgement on site, and the manager was often reached only by waiting in the corridor.
tasks.enabler_now: A short form can hold location, system and what was seen, and can sit in the manager's queue when they are off site.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding that a fault is major, and explaining urgency to a manager who wants to see it, stays with the janitor.
tasks.human_edge: The janitor knows which noises and leaks are ordinary for that plant room and which ones are new.

ambition.what: Managers who are off site when the fault is found, so the notice does not wait for the next shared shift.

tasks.altitude: The janitor still does not approve spend. The new reach is that an off-site manager can read the same notice.

reach.task: Decide whether to commission a major building repair
reach.learn: Which fields the manager needs before they will visit, so the notice does not bounce.

evidence.claim: A structured repair note can carry location and what was seen. It does not decide that a fault is major. This is model knowledge, and this job has no digest.

assumptions: The notice fields are site, location, building system, what was seen, and whether water or power is involved. The janitor writes them. If the form is down, the same fields go on paper and the conversation still happens.
Commissioning the repair, and any contractor, is the manager's later task, not this one.
unknowns: Whether managers at this company already take repair asks by phone only, and whether a written notice would be ignored.
research_questions: How many major faults wait more than a day only because the janitor and the manager miss each other.

already_counted.description: The janitor rereads the repair notice before handing it on.

incremental.description: Retire notices that were duplicates of a fault already logged.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the scrap of paper becomes a short form. Finding the fault, judging it major, and telling the manager stay. A site where the manager is always in the next room saves almost nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order the supplies and equipment the cleaning round is short of.

steps.what: Check stores for cleaning supplies and equipment
Set quantities needed for maintenance duties
Draft the requisition for those supplies
Approve the supply requisition before ordering

tasks.design: Par levels for cleaning supplies sit on the {PROCUREMENT} item list. The janitor still checks the cupboard, adjusts the suggested quantity, and files a requisition the facilities supervisor releases. Placing the supplier order stays a later purchasing step.
tasks.previous_blocker: What is short is only visible in the cupboard, and the ask was a handwritten list that purchasing retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: A purchasing list can store a par quantity per item and prefill the requisition. The cupboard check still sets the truth.
tasks.still_hard: Counting what is actually on the shelf, and spotting a product that has been substituted, stays in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The janitor knows which items run out faster on a wet week and which spares are already borrowed from another site.
tasks.altitude: The janitor still cannot release spend. The supervisor keeps that release.

reach.task: Requisition seasonal materials for the same sites
reach.learn: Which items the grounds team already orders, so cleaning par levels do not duplicate them.

evidence.claim: A purchasing list can store a par quantity and prefill a requisition. It cannot see the cupboard. This is model knowledge, and this job has no digest.

assumptions: The requisition fields are item, quantity, unit, store location and needed-by date. The janitor confirms quantity. The facilities supervisor releases it. If the purchasing list has no par level, the janitor types the quantity.
The supplier purchase order is a later task of the purchasing team and is not time in this task.
unknowns: Whether this company lets a janitor raise a requisition, or whether a supervisor still writes every order from a paper list.
research_questions: How often a requisition is cut because the cupboard count and the par level disagree.

already_counted.description: The janitor adjusts suggested quantities after looking in the cupboard.
The janitor checks the draft requisition before it goes to the supervisor.

incremental.description: Update a par level when a product is replaced or a site's usage shifts.

approvals.approved_version: requisition draft with item, quantity, unit and store location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The cupboard check stays. Time drops only where a par list already matches the items in that cupboard, so the janitor edits quantities instead of writing the list out. Sites that still use a paper list, and the par-level upkeep, keep the saving small. The supervisor's release is not the janitor's time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The janitor still walks the building, locks up, spots faults and checks the cupboard. Closing notes, repair notices and supply requests become short forms. There is no new right to approve spend or to change who may enter.
reach: Housekeeping cleaners note room defects; learn which defects they already log before adding them to the repair notice.
Groundskeeping workers requisition seasonal materials; learn which items they share so par levels are not duplicated.
The facilities supervisor releases the cleaning requisition; learn which quantities they always cut.
skills_to_grow: Tell a hazard from ordinary wear while walking the round.
Write a repair notice a manager can act on without a second visit.
Keep par quantities matched to what the cupboard actually holds.
role.ambitious_version: One closing list and one repair form cover the sites this janitor walks. The round itself is unchanged.

job.title: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
